narrative: Exploratory: Aktia has not decided to replace its consolidation system, but wants to know whether the planning platform could also cover consolidation. The group is simple — three main entities, all in euros, about €11.5M a year of eliminations (mostly fund and insurance distribution commissions to the bank, and service recharges). GL actuals for all entities are already in Snowflake, so matching and eliminating them is a query, and the result can feed Workiva, which stays the reporting layer.
